comment: Event -> possible narrator lines. Lines are picked at random per event. Audio files (assets/voice/) will map by line id later; V1 scaffold shows captions only.

game.start: Welcome to Jamaica, brethren! Touch di road!
community.enter: {community} nice up — big up di community!
dog.chase: Dog dem a bark and chase — gun it, nuh!
Watch out! Dem yard dog nuh play wid yuh!
Move, pup! Di road nah fi yuh!
goat.hit: Lawd have mercy — yuh lick down di goat!
Yuh nyam down a goat, breddah! Dat nuh right!
Respect di road animals, man! Goat have feelings too!
goat.near_miss: Careful wid di goat dem — dem nuh signal before dem cross!
Nearly! Di goat dem a test yuh reflexes!
